The subject’s face must remain 100% identical to the reference photo — no changes to facial structure, proportions, skin tone, beard shape, jawline, nose, lips, eyes, or expression.

The artwork features a half-body portrait of a young man with a rugged yet refined look, captured in a dramatic close-up framing with a slightly low-angle perspective. His expression is intense, thoughtful, and emotionally charged, with subtle tension in the brows and a focused gaze directed straight at the viewer.

Hair & Grooming:
His dark hair is windswept and dynamic, styled with natural volume and movement, individual strands sharply defined to convey motion. He has a well-groomed short beard and mustache, with realistic density and natural edges.

Hands & Details:
One hand is raised near the chin in a casual, contemplative pose. The hand features detailed black ink tattoos on the fingers and wrist, rendered with sharp line clarity and realistic skin interaction.

Clothing:
He is wearing an oversized black hoodie, matte fabric with soft folds and natural drape. The hoodie should feel realistic, slightly loose, and well-integrated into the portrait without distracting from the face.

Lighting & Texture:
Use bright, even studio lighting with soft highlights that enhance facial contours. Skin texture must be clearly visible, including fine pores, subtle freckles, natural blemishes, and gentle shadow transitions. Eyes should have vivid reflections and lifelike depth, adding intensity and realism.

Background & Color:
Set the subject against a solid, bold, vibrant yellow background, clean and seamless, creating strong contrast with the black hoodie and skin tones. The background should be flat and graphic, enhancing poster-style impact.

Style & Quality:
Blend semi-photorealistic and semi-illustrative aesthetics, characteristic of modern high-end poster art. Emphasize clarity, sharp edges, rich color saturation, and dynamic energy. Ultra-high resolution, crisp details, smooth gradients, professional illustration finish.

Do not alter the subject. Use the uploaded image strictly as reference.
